description: Test per-cell ROC-AUC on the precious-metal (Ru, Ir, Rh, Os, Re) 9-cell-line subset of MetalCytoToxDB overlapping with the NCI-60 panel (k=9 cell lines) with D-MPNN k-cell-line multi-task (9 cls + 9 reg heads).
unit: ROC-AUC (0-1, higher better) per cell line
honest_framing: Data source: MetalCytoToxDB precious-metal (Ru, Ir, Rh, Os, Re) x NCI-60 9-cell-line subset (5,207 rows); NCI-60 raw release has no SMILES so we use MetalCytoToxDB precious subset restricted to NCI-60-overlapping cell lines. Model: D-MPNN k-cell-line multi-task (dmpnn_kcell_multitask) with 9 cls + 9 reg heads. Protocol: scaffold split, 3 seeds [0,1,2], 50 epochs. Krasnov 2026 baseline = 0.81 cite-only; iMoLD cite-only. NOT a head-to-head against Krasnov chemprop v2 reference — same-protocol comparison requires chemprop v2 backbone + full training. Cites TODO-140/141/142/143/144.
framing: NCI-60 raw release has no SMILES; we use the MetalCytoToxDB precious-metal subset restricted to 9 NCI-60-overlapping cell lines.
